nodes.description: SafeMath.safeAdd(uint a, uint b): performs c = a + b and requires c >= a to prevent arithmetic overflow
SafeMath.safeSub(uint a, uint b): requires b <= a then returns a - b, preventing underflow
SafeMath.safeMul(uint a, uint b): multiplies and verifies a == 0 || c / a == b to prevent overflow
SafeMath.safeDiv(uint a, uint b): requires b > 0 then divides
ERC20Interface.totalSupply() external interface declaration returning total token supply
ERC20Interface.transfer(address to, uint tokens) external interface declaration invoked on arbitrary token contracts
ERC20Interface.approve(address spender, uint tokens) external interface declaration
ERC20Interface.transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens) external interface declaration
ERC20Interface.balanceOf(address tokenOwner) external interface declaration
ERC20Interface.allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender) external interface declaration
ApproveAndCallFallBack.receiveApproval(address from, uint256 tokens, address token, bytes data) external callback entered by the token contract
Owned() constructor assigning contract ownership to the deployer (msg.sender)
Owned.transferOwnership(address _newOwner) onlyOwner: stages a pending owner for two-step transfer
Owned.acceptOwnership(): requires msg.sender == newOwner, then commits ownership and clears newOwner
NeLunaCoin() constructor: mints _devTokens and _totalSupply and pre-credits the dev address balance
NeLunaCoin.totalSupply() constant: returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)]
NeLunaCoin.balanceOf(address tokenOwner) constant: returns the recorded balance
NeLunaCoin.transfer(address to, uint tokens): debits msg.sender and credits 'to' using SafeMath
NeLunaCoin.approve(address spender, uint tokens): writes the allowance mapping for msg.sender
NeLunaCoin.transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens): debits balance and allowance, credits 'to'
NeLunaCoin.allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender) constant: returns the allowance mapping value
NeLunaCoin.approveAndCall(address spender, uint tokens, bytes data): writes allowance then invokes receiveApproval on spender
NeLunaCoin payable fallback: mints 1000 tokens per wei of msg.value to balances[msg.sender]
NeLunaCoin.transferAnyERC20Token(address tokenAddress, uint tokens) onlyOwner: external transfer from an arbitrary token contract
